request: how does a ship measure the depth of the sea with sound?

beats.intent: A ship on the surface with the sea floor far below
beats.narration: A ship sends a pulse of sound straight down.
beats.code:
stage.title("Sonar")
surface = Line([-6, 2.0, 0], [6, 2.0, 0], color=BLUE)
floor = Line([-6, -2.6, 0], [6, -2.6, 0], color=ORANGE, stroke_width=6)
ship = Polygon([-1, 2.0, 0], [1, 2.0, 0], [1.3, 2.5, 0], [-1.3, 2.5, 0], color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.8)
stage.play(Create(surface), Create(floor), FadeIn(ship))
stage.add(surface, floor, ship)

beats.intent: A pulse arrow travelling down to the floor and an echo arrow coming back up
beats.narration: The pulse travels down, bounces off the sea floor, and the echo comes back up.
beats.code:
down = Arrow([-0.3, 1.9, 0], [-0.3, -2.5, 0], buff=0, color=YELLOW)
up = Arrow([0.3, -2.5, 0], [0.3, 1.9, 0], buff=0, color=GREEN)
stage.play(GrowArrow(down), run_time=1.2)
stage.play(GrowArrow(up), run_time=1.2)
stage.add(down, up)
stage.label(down, "pulse", direction=LEFT, color=YELLOW)
stage.label(up, "echo", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: A stopwatch reading 4 seconds for the round trip
beats.narration: The echo arrives four seconds later.
beats.code:
watch = Circle(radius=0.6, color=WHITE).move_to([4.0, 0, 0])
hand = Line(watch.get_center(), watch.get_center() + 0.5 * UP, color=RED)
stage.play(Create(watch), Create(hand))
stage.play(Rotate(hand, -TAU * 4 / 12, about_point=watch.get_center()))
stage.add(watch, hand)
stage.label(watch, "4 s", direction=DOWN)

beats.narration: Sound travels about fifteen hundred metres a second in sea water. Four seconds is there and back, so halve it: three thousand metres deep.

request: how does a cell divide into two?

beats.intent: A round cell with two chromosome strands inside
beats.narration: A cell carries its instructions on chromosomes, here just two to keep it simple.
beats.code:
stage.title("Cell division")
cell = Circle(radius=2.0, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to([0, -0.3, 0])
chroms = VGroup(Line([-0.6, 0.3, 0], [-0.2, -0.7, 0], color=RED, stroke_width=10), Line([0.3, 0.2, 0], [0.7, -0.8, 0], color=BLUE, stroke_width=10))
stage.play(Create(cell), Create(chroms))
stage.add(cell, chroms)

beats.intent: Each chromosome copied, the pairs lined up across the middle
beats.narration: First it copies each chromosome, and the copies line up across the middle.
beats.code:
pairs = VGroup()
for y, col in ((0.4, RED), (-0.8, BLUE)):
    pairs.add(Line([-0.15, y + 0.4, 0], [-0.15, y - 0.4, 0], color=col, stroke_width=10), Line([0.15, y + 0.4, 0], [0.15, y - 0.4, 0], color=col, stroke_width=10))
stage.play(Transform(chroms, pairs))
stage.caption("copy, then line up")

beats.intent: The copies pulled to opposite ends and the cell pinching in the middle
beats.narration: Fibres pull one copy of each to opposite ends, and the cell pinches in the middle.
beats.code:
left = VGroup(pairs[0].copy(), pairs[2].copy())
right = VGroup(pairs[1].copy(), pairs[3].copy())
stage.play(FadeOut(chroms), FadeIn(left), FadeIn(right))
stage.play(left.animate.shift(1.2 * LEFT), right.animate.shift(1.2 * RIGHT))
waist = Ellipse(width=4.6, height=2.6, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to(cell)
stage.play(Transform(cell, waist))
stage.add(left, right)

beats.intent: Two new cells, each with one red and one blue chromosome
beats.narration: It splits into two cells, each with a full copy of the instructions.
beats.code:
c1 = Circle(radius=1.3, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to([-1.9, -0.3, 0])
c2 = Circle(radius=1.3, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to([1.9, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(Transform(cell, VGroup(c1, c2)), left.animate.move_to(c1), right.animate.move_to(c2))
stage.caption("two cells, same instructions")

request: what's the area of a quarter of a circle with radius 4?

beats.intent: A circle of radius 4 with its radius drawn
beats.narration: A circle with radius four has area pi times sixteen, about fifty point three.
beats.code:
stage.title("Area of a sector")
c = np.array([-2.5, -0.5, 0])
k = 0.6
circ = Circle(radius=4 * k, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to(c)
r = Line(c, c + 4 * k * RIGHT, color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(circ), Create(r))
stage.add(circ, r)
stage.label(r, "4", direction=DOWN, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A 90° slice shaded, a quarter of the circle
beats.narration: Cut out a ninety degree slice, a quarter of a full turn.
beats.code:
sector = Sector(radius=4 * k, start_angle=0, angle=PI / 2, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.7).move_arc_center_to(c)
stage.play(FadeIn(sector))
stage.add(sector)
stage.label(sector, "90°", direction=UR, color=ORANGE)

beats.intent: Four such slices tiling the circle
beats.narration: Four of them fill the circle, so it has a quarter of the area.
beats.code:
more = VGroup(*[Sector(radius=4 * k, start_angle=a, angle=PI / 2, color=col, fill_opacity=0.35).move_arc_center_to(c) for a, col in ((PI / 2, GREEN), (PI, RED), (3 * PI / 2, PURPLE))])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(m) for m in more], lag_ratio=0.3))
stage.add(more)
stage.caption("4 quarters make the circle")

beats.narration: Any slice is its angle over three sixty, times the whole area: here about twelve point six.

request: where is the balance point of a triangle?

beats.narration: Cut a triangle out of card. Where could you balance it on a pin?
beats.code:
stage.title("A triangle's balance point")
A, B, C = np.array([-3.5, -2.2, 0]), np.array([3.0, -1.8, 0]), np.array([-0.5, 2.2, 0])
tri = Polygon(A, B, C, color=WHITE, fill_color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.35)
stage.play(Create(tri))
stage.add(tri)

beats.intent: A line from each corner to the midpoint of the opposite side
beats.narration: Draw a line from each corner to the middle of the opposite side: a median.
beats.code:
meds = VGroup(*[DashedLine(P, (Q + R) / 2, color=YELLOW) for P, Q, R in ((A, B, C), (B, C, A), (C, A, B))])
mids = VGroup(*[Dot((Q + R) / 2, color=YELLOW, radius=0.07) for _, Q, R in ((A, B, C), (B, C, A), (C, A, B))])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(m) for m in meds], lag_ratio=0.3), FadeIn(mids))
stage.add(meds, mids)

beats.intent: The three medians meeting at one point, marked G
beats.narration: All three meet at a single point.
beats.code:
G = (A + B + C) / 3
g = Dot(G, color=RED, radius=0.12)
stage.play(GrowFromCenter(g))
stage.add(g)
stage.label(g, "G", direction=UR, color=RED)

beats.intent: A pin under G with the triangle balanced, beside G = average of the corners
beats.narration: That point, the centroid, is where the triangle balances. Its position is just the average of the three corners.
beats.code:
pin = Line(G + 0.1 * DOWN, G + 2.6 * DOWN, color=GREY_A, stroke_width=6).set_z_index(1)
stage.play(Create(pin))
stage.add(pin)
stage.equation(r"G = \frac{A + B + C}{3}")
